name: Dried tomato & plum bread spread
author: patryk-niedźwiedziński on based.cooking

ingredients.item: pinch of chilli (optional, if you like it to be spicy)

steps: Put plums in hot water from kettle for couple of minutes, in order to make them softer.
After that put plums (without the water) and rest of the ingredients into blender and mix it until you're satisfied.
If you want to make it more liquid you can add water from the plums.

culture.text: A spread is a food that is spread, generally with a knife, onto foods such as bread or crackers. Spreads are added to food to enhance the flavor or texture of the food, which may be considered bland without it. Butter and soft cheeses are typical spreads.
